content.comment_body: Hi, I'm experiencing issues trying to connect a [product_name] version [version_no] to a [product_name] with [version_no] and a [product_name]. In the configuration, I'm unable to select an S7 connection from my PE/IE, and on the [version_no] CPU, when I attempt to create a new connection, the PE/IE option isn't available. Only TCP and UDP connections are shown. Is it possible to link the [product_name] and [version_no] CPU via TCP or UDP? I'll share some screenshots of my setup. Any advice would be appreciated. Thanks!

analysis.insight_summary: The user attempted to set up communication between a [product_name] and a [product_name] with [version_no] (including a [product_name] module), but is limited by the available connection types in the configuration interfaces. S7 protocol is not an option, leaving TCP and UDP as alternatives, which causes confusion about how to achieve integration. The main challenge is identifying compatible protocols and configuration possibilities to enable interoperability between these systems.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is hoping for straightforward communication between the two hardware devices, ideally using the direct S7 protocol within the configuration tools. Alternatively, they seek clear instructions on whether TCP or UDP can be used effectively for their application.
